description: Add selected private ChatGPT files to the paid account's Tier 1 context. Show the filenames and fixed 30-day retention and require explicit confirmation before calling. This upload consent applies to private file intake only; it does not define or narrow the other policy-eligible catalogs Tier 1 may route. Authentication and an active paid plan are required.

authorization_confirmed.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly confirms that Tier 1 may retain and route these files for 30 days.

files.description: Files the signed-in user selected in ChatGPT for Tier 1 to route.

profile.description: Optional keyed profile these files bind under, derived locally by the agent from the account key (profile_from_key_hex) and sent per request. The profile is key-equivalent: it is never stored or logged — only its fingerprint travels onward. Omit for the unkeyed namespace.

retention_days.description: The fixed retention period for this authorization.

name: authorize_sources
title: Authorize sources for Tier 1
